releases.title: Initial Mission Control baseline
releases.summary: Introduced the local GBrain-backed task interface with Today, Inbox, Upcoming, Blocked, Projects, Goals, Completed, Quick Add, and verified task details.

releases.title: Reliable task workflow and Board
releases.summary: Added status editing, the task Board, and reciprocal goal links; normalized lifecycle relationships so every valid task stays visible exactly once without hidden-task issues.

releases.title: Next actions and automatic refresh
releases.summary: Added verified Next Action editing in task details and a visible read-only refresh every 30 minutes that coalesces requests, defers while hidden, and resumes when the page is visible.

releases.title: Durable projects and faster reads
releases.summary: Added verified GBrain project creation, persistent zero-task project cards, separate task assignment, and bounded parallel reads to reduce task-loading latency.

releases.title: Immediate verified status updates
releases.summary: Status changes now reconcile from canonical GBrain readback immediately; Board adds keyboard/touch movement and silent same-status no-ops. Projects are now limited to typed members of Tony's Projects, with first-use initialization and visible malformed-member diagnostics.

releases.title: Goal lifecycle controls and steadier reads
releases.summary: Added verified goal creation plus confirmed Pause and recoverable Delete workflows that preserve linked task content; capped GBrain read concurrency and coalesced duplicate initial loads while manual and automatic Refresh remain authoritative.

releases.title: Inbox-centered warning controls
releases.summary: Centralized task, project, goal, and relationship warnings in Inbox; added confirmed durable dismissal, restart-safe preferences, changed-issue reappearance, and a recoverable dismissed-warning list without hiding canonical data.

releases.title: Privacy-safe operational Logs
releases.summary: Added a read-only Logs dialog beside About with newest-first filtering and pagination, fixed-message Event Queue Reader history and health, bounded redacted Mission Control events, and graceful queue-unavailable status that never blocks core task workflows.

releases.title: Optional task progress and safe duplication
releases.summary: Full task creation can track an optional count metric with a clear preview, cards and details show verified progress, and Duplicate provides a reviewable clean copy with progress, evidence, receipts, and completion history reset. The job-applied binding uses the exact daily five-application contract and completes only after five distinct accepted events.

releases.title: Agent profiles and optional Board work
releases.summary: Agent Work now shows Toddy, Timmy, and Tammy with typed default-goal ownership and safe profile links. Board remains Tony-only by default; Show agent tasks reads the three canonical agent collections on demand, adds accessible owner and avatar badges, and keeps agent work visibly read-only and separate from Tony’s obligations.

releases.title: Agent proposal review
releases.summary: Inbox now shows canonical agent proposals grouped by Toddy, Timmy, and Tammy, distinguishes work proposed for Tony from proposed agent work, and provides explicit review, approval, and rejection flows with durable GBrain relationships and exact readback; empty state creates no suggestions.

releases.title: Explicit agent task assignment
releases.summary: Full Create Task now defaults to Tony but can create one verified queued work item for Toddy, Timmy, or Tammy with exact typed collection membership and assigned_to ownership, no duplicate Tony task or proposal; agent cards retain owner avatars and support authoritative status updates.

releases.title: One full Create Task flow
releases.summary: Removed the reduced Quick Add interface. Create Task is now the only visible task-creation action in the sidebar and at the top of Today and Inbox; all three open the same full form with due date, assignee, project, goal, and optional metric support, and the N shortcut opens that full form.

releases.title: Unified task editing
releases.summary: Task details are now read-only until Edit opens one full form for task fields, status, project, associated goal, optional metric, and assignee. Saves use canonical GBrain readback; agent handoffs retain the same task and a durable assignment history.

releases.title: Mission Control, avatars, and simpler navigation
releases.summary: GTasks is now visibly Mission Control while preserving its local service and GBrain identity. Agent profiles can safely upload a verified avatar through local Memory Stargraph storage, while cards retain accessible text names and initials fallback. The sidebar is now text-first and Upcoming has been removed as a redundant top-level view; future tasks remain canonical and available through their details, projects, and goals.

releases.title: Safer agents and goal ownership
releases.summary: Avatar upload now validates the exact selected Agent Directory slug and typed agent page before sending any image to Memory Stargraph. Validated local previews render immediately with an accessible file name and clear safely after cancellation, failure, or verified upload. Agent Profiles can assign or unassign default goals through the same verified GBrain relationship shown in Goal details.

releases.title: Reliable agent avatar identity
releases.summary: Agent avatars now preserve each profile’s canonical Agent identity after Memory Stargraph attachment verification, so avatar changes cannot make Toddy, Timmy, or Tammy disappear from Agent Work.

releases.title: Tony avatar on Board
releases.summary: Board cards for Tony’s personal tasks now display Tony’s canonical GBrain profile avatar, with a safe initials fallback if the profile image is unavailable.

releases.title: Reliable Agent Work rendering
releases.summary: Fixed Agent Work and Proposed Tasks to use the shared owner/avatar renderer, preventing a JavaScript exception that left the previous view visible after navigation; added regression coverage for both agent surfaces.

releases.title: Clear agent profiles
releases.summary: Agents now show their current verified avatar with a focused replacement control, render canonical profile Markdown as readable structured content without duplicating the attachment block, and use the simpler Agents navigation label.

releases.title: Weekly due-date view
releases.summary: Added Week: a read-only Monday-to-Sunday view of Tony’s active tasks grouped by their canonical GBrain due date, with previous, next, and current-week controls plus clear empty days.

releases.title: Editable goals and simpler duplication
releases.summary: Goal details now include Edit for verified canonical updates to goal fields while preserving relationships and lifecycle state. Task details now label the copy action simply Duplicate.

releases.title: Calendar, project goals, and agent summaries
releases.summary: Calendar now offers Week and Month due-date views. Projects can select multiple canonical Goals through verified supports_goal links, and Agent cards show owned goals and authorized-work summaries with profile actions in an accessible menu.

releases.title: Same-task agent proposals
releases.summary: Agent proposals are now normal agent-owned tasks with status proposed. Inbox keeps them separate from executable work, shows concise safe Markdown details, and approval changes the exact same task to planned after canonical readback; legacy proposal pages remain read-only compatibility records.

releases.title: Read-only agent coordination
releases.summary: Agents now includes a read-only Coordinator summary of canonical agent work: active, proposed, blocked, completed, recent verified completions, and malformed-state triage. It never executes, approves, edits, reassigns, or claims work.

releases.title: Focused proposal review
releases.summary: Proposed Tasks now uses title-only rows with compact Edit, Approve, and Reject actions. The selected task’s full safe Markdown, agent and Goal context, timestamps, and matching review actions stay in More details; decision notes use a clear full-width field on desktop and mobile.

releases.title: Wider responsive workspace
releases.summary: Mission Control now uses the available desktop workspace between its sidebar and detail panel. Calendar gives seven equal desktop day columns, task titles wrap safely inside their day cells, and Project copy clearly distinguishes Create a Project from Edit.

releases.title: Clearer Agent Work cards
releases.summary: Every Agent card now uses one compact, accessible three-dot control to open its profile directly. Current work uses a consistent structured summary, including a single calm empty state instead of duplicate system messages.

releases.title: Fail-closed proposed work validation
releases.summary: Mission Control now keeps any proposed agent record with a non-task type out of review and executable surfaces, and reports the exact canonical type problem in Inbox Needs Attention without changing the record.

releases.title: Canonical entity type preservation
releases.summary: Every preserved Mission Control update now writes back the entity type it first read from GBrain. Task updates fail closed if that type is not task, preventing accidental task-to-concept downgrades.

releases.title: Compact Calendar Week cards
releases.summary: Calendar Week cards now use compact, readable task typography that wraps safely inside each day at narrow desktop widths and on mobile, without changing Month view.

releases.title: Readable narrow Calendar Week
releases.summary: Week cards now retain compact Goal metadata and use a horizontally scrollable row of equal-width days when an open detail panel would otherwise make desktop cards unreadable.

releases.title: Accurate planned Agent Work
releases.summary: Historical approved or rejected proposal records no longer appear in active Proposed Tasks, so the canonical planned Agent work remains visible through its intended work surfaces.

releases.title: Contained narrow Calendar scrolling
releases.summary: Calendar Week now keeps its own horizontal scroller within the visible workspace when task details are open at narrow desktop widths, so every day through Sunday remains reachable without moving the app shell.

releases.title: Calendar safety and clearer work states
releases.summary: Calendar adds an opt-in read-only local iCalendar overlay with explicit permission states, while overdue executable tasks are highlighted consistently. Proposed Task cards open details directly, and legacy waiting tasks now display as Blocked without changing canonical data.

releases.title: Mobile proposal details
releases.summary: Selecting a Proposed Task on a phone now brings its populated read-only detail panel into view and moves focus to its title, while preserving compact Inbox review actions.

releases.title: Contained mobile Calendar scrolling
releases.summary: Calendar Week now keeps its horizontal day strip inside the mobile Calendar area, so reaching later days never slides the Mission Control page or navigation sideways.

releases.title: Reliable canonical Goal reading
releases.summary: Goals now read their validated compiled Markdown contract when GBrain exposes a generic raw storage type, preserving renamed display labels, linked task navigation, and progress without false data warnings.

releases.title: Mission Control System Tickets
releases.summary: Added a separate GBrain-backed System Tickets surface with verified canonical task creation, target subsystem, verbatim request, acceptance criteria, priority, and implementation and independent UX QA receipt visibility.

releases.title: System Ticket compatibility
releases.summary: Existing Mission Control System Tickets now remain visible when their original request is stored in the canonical task detail field, without rewriting the ticket.

releases.title: Reliable System Ticket visibility
releases.summary: System Tickets now retry their canonical read after the initial task sync and clearly show any malformed ticket data with a safe inspection path instead of a silent empty state.

releases.title: Compact Mission Control actions
releases.summary: Mission Control now uses accessible icon controls with clear hover and keyboard labels for standard actions, a narrower navigation rail, and more compact first-view ticket cards while keeping full details available on demand.

releases.title: Contained mobile navigation
releases.summary: Keeps Mission Control navigation and horizontal content inside the mobile viewport while preserving their own scroll controls.

releases.title: Stable desktop detail layout
releases.summary: Prevents a closed detail pane from expanding the desktop canvas, keeping compact content and local scroll areas contained.

releases.title: Contained Mission Control canvas
releases.summary: Keeps offscreen card rails from widening the Mission Control desktop canvas while preserving local scrolling.

releases.title: Focused navigation and Mission Control identity
releases.summary: Moves task and ticket counts into their page headings, keeps the navigation rail category-focused, and adds the distinct Mission Control mark and browser icons.

releases.title: Verified Mission Control identity
releases.summary: Serves the distinct Mission Control command mark and browser icons reliably while keeping the rejected central illustration out of the product.

releases.title: Accurate System Ticket count
releases.summary: Shows the current System Ticket count in its page heading so it matches the canonical ticket list.

releases.title: Protect lifecycle changes and calendar privacy
releases.summary: Tasks now fail safely when lifecycle membership needs repair, navigation controls are easier to use, Inbox selections open details, and Calendar uses a read-only selected-calendar connection.

releases.title: Use Mission Control Calendar access
releases.summary: Calendar access now launches a branded Mission Control helper before Apple Full Access permission, then lets you choose read-only calendars.

releases.title: North Star dark command center
releases.summary: Mission Control now uses its distinct North Star and Big Dipper logo, matching favicon, English celestial word artwork, and a compact Memory Stargraph-family dark HUD across desktop and mobile.

releases.title: Reliable agent work on Board
releases.summary: Board now preserves the Show agent tasks preference and reliably loads eligible agent work whenever you return or refresh.

releases.title: Accessible North Star command center
releases.summary: Mission Control's dark North Star HUD now gives every visible mobile action a full 44-pixel touch target while preserving the compact desktop rail and centered celestial artwork.

releases.title: Persistent agent-task Board filter
releases.summary: Show agent tasks now survives browser refresh with a durable local preference, while keeping the Board separate from Tony’s personal task list by default.

releases.title: Reliable dark command center startup
releases.summary: Mission Control now initializes the persisted Board preference before the interface starts, so the North Star dark HUD renders reliably on every load.

releases.title: Reliable agent work recovery
releases.summary: Board now keeps Tony’s work visible and explains when GBrain cannot read agent work, while preserving the selected agent-task filter across refreshes.

releases.title: Reliable mobile agent task details
releases.summary: Agent work cards now keep their verified detail available when selected on mobile, even if a background refresh finishes at the same time.

releases.title: Usable mobile task details
releases.summary: Opening a task on a phone now presents its details in an immediate focused sheet, including agent work and its Markdown notes.

releases.title: Navigation and Calendar recovery
releases.summary: Enlarges the Mission Control rail controls, moves the linked release version beside the celestial word artwork, replaces Inbox Reject text with an accessible red icon, and makes failed or disconnected local Calendar overlays recoverable without a retry loop.

releases.title: System Ticket processing and Calendar selection
releases.summary: Clarifies that nightly work considers every planned System Ticket, records an execution or blocking outcome for each, and visibly marks the selected Calendar task in Week and Month views.

releases.title: Durable Next Action timeline
releases.summary: Preserves each replaced or cleared Next Action as a completed history entry, shows the current and completed timeline in task details, and keeps the selected Calendar card visible when the detail panel opens.

releases.title: Editable System Tickets and HUD controls
releases.summary: Adds verified same-ticket editing in the right detail panel, replaces native/pseudo tooltips with one Memory Stargraph-style HUD overlay, moves service and utility controls around the centered word art, and introduces an original envelope-check Inbox icon.

releases.title: Stable canonical identities
releases.summary: New Goals, Projects, and Tasks now use title-independent opaque IDs. The verified migration preserves readable titles, content, typed relationships, and legacy links while repairing Tony’s Goals membership without reviving the soft-deleted ERFA task.

releases.title: Proposal decision history
releases.summary: Keeps approved and rejected proposals visible in Inbox with atomic canonical decision events, review-state labels, and a durable task-detail timeline.

releases.title: Canonical TODOs and responsive reads
releases.summary: Replaces single Next Action editing with stable per-task TODO records, append-only comments, idempotent audit history, and verified item-level APIs. Task and proposal reads now coalesce in the background, retain clearly labelled last-verified data during slow GBrain refreshes, and define an explicit isolated QA-fixture scope so test work cannot become Tony work.

releases.title: Focused TODO entry and Project details
releases.summary: Keeps Task TODOs read-only until an explicit accessible Plus action opens the Add form, and makes every Project card open a focus-managed right sidebar with canonical description, status, relationships, timestamps, identity-preserving Edit, and verified readback.

releases.title: Verified Agent handoffs and Calendar selection
releases.summary: Makes every Agent information request a canonical Blocked task with a precise question and resume action. Answer and Hand Back records Tony's answer, completes the question, returns the same task to its assigned Agent with exact readback, and supports acknowledgement plus bounded follow-up questions without creating a new task. Calendar selection is compact, reports verified save feedback, and correctly reads selected EventKit events through the branded read-only helper.

releases.title: Show blocked Agent work
releases.summary: Today and Blocked now load and display canonical blocked Agent tasks alongside Tony tasks, with deduplicated counts and refresh behavior.

releases.title: Focused controls and compact history
releases.summary: Makes Agent profile metadata readable and keeps avatar and goal-edit controls behind explicit compact actions, replaces TODO status buttons with an unchecked Show completed ones checkbox, and keeps completed System Tickets out of the initial read until requested in five-ticket pages.

releases.title: Canonical Agent Artifacts
releases.summary: GBrain is the only Artifact source of truth. Each durable Agent deliverable has one producing-Agent collection membership with typed Task and Agent provenance, while Mission Control adds safe read-only browsing and task discovery.

releases.title: Responsive verified workflow surfaces
releases.summary: Keeps Mission Control usable during slow canonical reads with a bounded, clearly labelled last-verified System Ticket view and non-blocking refreshes. All Tasks and search share one reversible rolling-month date scope, Inbox shows only pending proposed work, Calendar restores its verified connection and selection without permission prompts, Artifact detail uses a wider reader, Task/Project/Goal writes share accessible HUD feedback, and TODO wording is consistent throughout.

releases.title: Navigable artifacts and adaptive details
releases.summary: Adds canonical Agent-to-Goal-to-Project-to-producing-Task Artifact browsing with a Recent alternative, read-only Calendar event time/details, a verified Manage-calendars connection state without redundant reconnect controls, and a desktop detail panel that can be resized and remembered while mobile keeps its full-sheet view.

releases.title: Reliable agent handoff completion
releases.summary: Completing an acknowledged Agent handoff now clears the resolved handoff before canonical readback, and repeating completion safely repairs an already-partial terminal task while preserving its original completion time.

releases.title: Verified job-application progress
releases.summary: Restores the durable job_applied consumer in the canonical repository with one explicit task binding, restart-safe idempotency, verified GBrain readback, preserved manual baseline and target values, privacy-safe activity receipts, recoverable binding warnings, and a clear scoped progress breakdown in Task Edit. Task Edit and Duplicate now open on the first activation while canonical choices load, legacy verified evidence stays visibly protected, and concurrent read-only Calendar helper calls recover from transient LaunchServices failures.

releases.title: Focused Artifact navigation and Calendar controls
releases.summary: Artifact details now open their canonical producing Task and return to the same Artifact context, while the hierarchy uses compact title-only Task rows with clear Default Goal and Default Project labels. A healthy Calendar connection shows one concise Manage action and transient verified-selection feedback.

releases.title: Event-driven Agent handoffs
releases.summary: Verified canonical task changes now produce event-driven Agent handoffs for one identity-scoped local Dispatcher and one existing fixed Codex thread. Task Timeline and Handoff Log show the same redacted append-only audit events, including bounded recovery-safe retry and failure evidence.

releases.title: Semantic Agent answer handoffs
releases.summary: Mission Control now classifies Tony answers by semantic effect across task fields, body text, TODO updates, and comments; material answer revisions create a new idempotent Agent handoff, duplicate saves remain Timeline-only, and Tony-owned tasks are logged as informational with no Agent handoff required.

releases.title: Consolidated handoff history surfaces
releases.summary: Keeps Task Timeline collapsed at the bottom of task details, removes self-navigation controls from task-local handoff events, and consolidates user-facing Handoff History into the Agents surface with safe legacy routing.

releases.title: Verified compact handoff task links
releases.summary: Agents Handoff History now uses verified server-projected Task references with compact inline title links, non-clickable unavailable fallbacks, Unicode-safe truncation, and denser timestamp/detail rows without redundant event-type labels.

releases.title: Reliable completed System Ticket handoff links
releases.summary: Handoff History now opens completed System Tickets through an exact canonical slug read instead of depending on the default uncompleted-ticket list, while preserving the existing privacy-safe task reference and detail focus behavior.

releases.title: Calendar toolbar and TODO completion controls
releases.summary: Calendar navigation now keeps Week/Month controls and Show iCal Events together with task details open, TODO edits can be saved with Done or Task completion in one verified flow, and GBrain communication states use the dark Mission Control HUD treatment.

releases.title: Framed word art and priority sidebar order
releases.summary: Mission Control now frames the central word art in a dark HUD treatment while preserving its lights, and the sidebar navigation follows the requested priority order from Today through Goals without changing destinations or accessibility labels.

releases.title: Board movement and verified card metadata
releases.summary: Restores safe Board drag-and-drop status movement, shows verified Project titles instead of raw slugs on task cards, opens Task details immediately with a busy GBrain read state for cold selections, and refines the Mission Control word-art HUD frame so exterior light rings remain outside the frame.

releases.title: Single Mission Control word art
releases.summary: Replaces the central illustrated banner with a single Mission Control typographic artword in the Memory Stargraph family style, retaining a direct dark HUD frame and blue-white glowing lights around the words.

releases.title: OpenClaw Agents and temporary delegation
releases.summary: Adds three independent fixed-session OpenClaw Agents and Tony-authorized time-bounded delegation that preserves permanent ownership and prioritizes each OpenClaw Agent's own work.

releases.title: Authenticated local dispatcher activation preflight
releases.summary: Requires each paired local Dispatcher worker to verify its authenticated canonical Agent registration and local Mission Control route through a no-side-effect POST before legacy replacement or installation mutation.

releases.title: Reliable local dispatcher authority acknowledgements
releases.summary: Gives authority-backed dispatcher mutations enough time to complete canonical registration and delegation readback while preserving durable idempotent retries and fail-closed wake ordering.

releases.title: Unified Task and System Ticket Markdown
releases.summary: New Tasks and System Tickets now use one safe Markdown formatter with exact canonical Ticket links, preserved user-authored details, and verified compiled-body readback.

releases.title: Reviewed Artifacts and newest-first work views
releases.summary: Adds explicit review-task Artifact links, sorts Artifacts and All Tasks by newest-updated time, and shows canonical status in All Tasks.

releases.title: Bounded rich Artifact publication
releases.summary: Allows authenticated Agent Artifact publication to carry complete evidence-rich Markdown up to a dedicated 256 KiB limit while keeping the generic 16 KiB mutation limit and rejecting oversized payloads before canonical writes.

releases.title: Canonical Artifact timestamp reconciliation
releases.summary: Treats canonical updated_at as server-managed metadata during Artifact publication verification and idempotent retry, while continuing to compare every requested content and provenance field.

releases.title: Reliable long-lived Task detail opening
releases.summary: Reopens the Task detail busy panel when a same-task canonical read is still in flight after long-lived session churn, while preserving one-read coalescing and final exact GBrain reconciliation.

releases.title: Faster open System Tickets and multiline TODO display
releases.summary: Avoids completed-ticket hydration fan-out for the default System Tickets view while preserving completed pagination, and renders user-authored TODO text, details, and comments with newline boundaries intact.

releases.title: Completed Task TODO reconciliation
releases.summary: Completing a Task now reconciles its direct child TODOs to done with verified readback, including legacy next-action TODOs, same-status repair retries, full Edit saves, and automation-created daily tasks without duplicating TODO history events.

releases.title: Reduce System Tickets refresh fan-out
releases.summary: Uses the last verified System Tickets snapshot as a status index so default refresh skips completed-ticket hydration, preserves completed-ticket reads when requested, and invalidates the ticket snapshots after verified ticket writes.

releases.title: Command Confirmation Sweep
releases.summary: Adds a local Command Confirmation Sweep after explicit Task completion is saved and read back from GBrain.

releases.title: Settings view for completion celebration
releases.summary: Moves the Completion celebration Full/Reduced/Off preference from About into a dedicated Settings view opened from the footer control group after About.

releases.title: Task parent relationship mutation
releases.summary: Adds verified parent_slug support to Mission Control task creation and full edit so Agent daily-run tasks can publish and read back canonical child_of relationships without raw graph writes.

releases.title: Completed task archive boundary
releases.summary: Adds an explicit verified archive-boundary repair path that moves completed Tony Tasks from Tony's active root to Tony's completed root after the next Monday in America/Los_Angeles, preserving task content and unrelated relationships with exact page/link readback and partial-failure reporting.

releases.title: Bounded long-open refresh scheduling
releases.summary: Prevents stale background refresh snapshots from rearming an expired zero-delay auto-refresh loop, preserving the bounded one-second surface poll and the normal 30-minute refresh cadence after long-open tabs.

releases.title: Bounded Task detail recovery
releases.summary: Task details now bound each exact GBrain read to a 15-second watchdog, cancel obsolete reads on Task switches or close, and offer an in-place retry without reloading Mission Control while preserving stale-response suppression and canonical reconciliation.

releases.title: Canonical delegation readback compatibility
releases.summary: Accepts Stargraph ingestion provenance metadata while preserving strict delegation contract validation, restoring Tammy-to-Tammy-OC authority enumeration and handoff preflight.

releases.title: Remote MCP task updates
releases.summary: Runs Mission Control through a dedicated authenticated GBrain remote-MCP thin client so canonical task reads and updates no longer depend on an unavailable local config.

releases.title: Direct GBrain runtime config fallback
releases.summary: Lets direct Mission Control GBrain adapter calls reuse the dashboard-declared remote MCP runtime config and private credential file when the user-level ~/.gbrain config has no remote_mcp block, preserving fail-closed permission checks.

releases.title: Focused Board and Agent coordination controls
releases.summary: Adds a configurable Board-first landing view, a session-scoped Board date window, a centered completion confirmation, resilient OpenClaw roster readback, and a durable fail-closed Buzz coordination outbox.

releases.title: Buzz bridge runtime activation
releases.summary: Activated the dashboard-managed Buzz coordination bridge with owner-only runtime credentials, a durable private outbox, fail-closed startup validation, and a verified accepted delivery receipt while keeping GBrain canonical.

releases.title: System Tickets canonical refresh fan-out repair
releases.summary: Preserve verified System Ticket snapshots across mutations and avoid rehydrating completed tickets on direct refresh.

releases.title: Module-root GBrain runtime fallback
releases.summary: Allows Mission Control GBrain adapter calls launched outside the repository, including Tammy automations, to reuse the dashboard-declared remote MCP runtime config and private credential file instead of falling back to the user's local PGlite graph.

releases.title: Canonical Tony root integrity surfaces
releases.summary: Protect Mission Control from false empty states when Tony task, goal, or project roots lose canonical membership readback.

releases.title: Reliable Goal readback
releases.summary: Goal creation and editing now verify the exact canonical Goal by slug before updating the interface, so stale task refreshes no longer make a successful Goal write look failed.

releases.title: Codex-only Goal execution canary
releases.summary: Adds risk-tiered Codex-only Goal-derived work planning with deterministic receipts, one-Goal work-in-progress, shadow and canary controls, exact canonical readback, and fixed-thread delivery; OpenClaw remains excluded.

releases.title: Approved paired Agent routes
releases.summary: Treats each exact verified registration as routable after the dispatcher validates approved Codex and OpenClaw host-route groups, accepts verified GBrain delegation ingestion metadata, while duplicate per-Agent registrations still fail closed and OpenClaw remains excluded from Goal execution.

releases.title: Expired handoff lease recovery
releases.summary: Reclaims expired Agent handoff leases at the next authenticated claim boundary, preserving append-only lease-expired evidence and allowing the same fixed-thread worker to retry without manual SQLite or GBrain edits.

releases.title: Recovered handoff wake launch
releases.summary: Promotes recovered accepted wake inbox items to pending at the worker claim boundary so an Agent that lost the received-acknowledgement window can launch the original goal-derived Task instead of rotating capabilities indefinitely.

releases.title: Recovered leased wake receipt
releases.summary: Receipts recovered leased Agent handoffs before opening any gated launch, including pre-grant start_requesting recovery, so stale local wake evidence cannot bypass the central received-state fence.

releases.title: Handoff wake identity normalization
releases.summary: Accepts both raw dispatcher registrations and already-normalized lease identities during canonical route validation so recovered leased handoffs can authorize wake without double-hashing.

releases.title: Privacy-safe handoff launch diagnostics
releases.summary: Classifies Codex fixed-thread active-writer failures without storing command output, giving Agent handoff recovery a concrete next action while preserving private stdout and stderr boundaries.

releases.title: Goal handoff repair visibility
releases.summary: Projects terminal Agent handoff delivery states into Goal execution and exact task details so active goal-derived work that failed delivery is surfaced as system-repair attention instead of a silent duplicate.

releases.title: Clearer Agent execution recovery copy
releases.summary: Clarifies Goal-derived task attention copy so checkpointed Agent execution recovery is described as verified handoff or execution review, not only delivery repair.

releases.title: Recover locked Agent handoff launches
releases.summary: Classifies Codex existing-invocation-lock launches as recoverable start conflicts so fixed-thread Agent handoffs abandon the unstarted attempt and retry instead of checkpointing as generic nonzero exits.

releases.title: Requeue verified execution recovery handoffs
releases.summary: Adds a bounded operator recovery path for checkpointed owned Agent executions, preserving the same durable handoff while clearing stale launch fences and returning it to retry after verified system repair.

releases.title: Replace terminal local inbox entries on retry
releases.summary: Allows a verified newer server retry for the same Agent handoff to replace stale terminal local wake-inbox evidence, clearing old launch fences so the fixed-thread dispatcher can start the recovered work.
